text:
Working on this month's story. We'll reveal who stars in it soon.
Last month was Before Returning to the Future, where Jon says goodbye to Clark Kent. It's still up if you missed it.
We know Ozai is locked up and must be bored out of his mind, but he's just had an unexpected visitor. Who do you think it is?

Looking through some old work, I found this drawing of Aladdin! I love this character.
Who's your favorite Disney character?
Rob Lucci wants to prove he's better than Zoro. How long do you think Zoro can last?

It's been a while since we did something Dragon Ball related.
Trunks finally defeated the androids, so now it's time to have some fun.

Our short story from last month. Nakamura watching Hirose take off his socks. Gym class was really exhausting.
Hope you like it!

What a great way to start the month with this duo! Koichi Haimawari and Knuckleduster.
It's been a while since I've seen them together.
This one's from last year, Spiderman from Marvel Rivals! I still like the Bag-Man outfit more, though.
Now that the prince is human again, Gaston has another chance to shine and prove he's the best!
A little volleyball never hurts. Ushiwaka and Oikawa just want to relax after a long training session.
